notes: Zone n_buildings of the normal area: the ten university buildings south of Normal Avenue and west of Valley Road, and their own small paving. The JSON is written by a generator (/tmp/claude-0/p5/normal/n_buildings/gen.py, scratch, not kept); this file is the source. Names: Van Reyper-Bond House (Bond House, 848 Valley Road, Italianate, 1872, National Register; Wikipedia), the President's House, Legge House (860 Valley Road), Coder House (10 Normal Avenue, the Center for Heritage and Archaeological Studies), the Center for Autism and Early Childhood Mental Health (14 Normal Avenue), the university houses at 18, 20 and 22 Normal Avenue (no names in any source) and a small university building (OSM 232846628, no name). 30 Normal Avenue lies outside the footprint and is not built. Method: the LiDAR here (2017 cloud, 3.7 points per m2, leaf-off) has no building class, so roofs are single returns more than 1.5 m above the ground (ground filled under the roofs from the nearest ground cells). Each house was read in a frame along its walls (the OSM wall direction), as a map of 0.5 m cells; every part is a rectangle split where the roof height or form changes. Pitched roofs: the ridge is the 0.5 m band with the highest returns, and each slope is a straight line fitted to its returns, its value at the wall line is the eave (fit rms 0.02 to 0.05 m on the Normal Avenue houses and Coder House, 0.14 to 0.53 m on the larger houses under trees). Flat and porch roofs: the 75th percentile of the returns. Outlines are the roof edges (eaves), so walls stand on the eave line. The 2020 ortho leans the taller roofs 1 to 3 m north-east (Bond House and the President's House most), so outlines come from the LiDAR only; the ortho gave roof colours, porches and the paving. Wall colours, doors, windows and the posts of the porches are not seen from above and are guessed. Paving: only a terrace at Legge House, a porch apron and a ramp landing at Coder House and a door step at the President's House, where the 2020 ortho shows paving and the roads zone's walks arrive; front stoops at 18 and 20 Normal Avenue show in the ortho but their place is uncertain under the lean: left out.
